#!/bin/bash
# Deploy main -> /var/www/html, dev -> /var/www/dev on push
set -u
DEPLOY_MAIN="/var/www/html"
DEPLOY_DEV="/var/www/dev"
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
  case "$refname" in
    refs/heads/main)
      if [ "$newrev" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_MAIN"
        if git --git-dir="/git/project" show "main:index.html" > "$DEPLOY_MAIN/index.html.tmp" 2>/dev/null; then

          chmod 644 "$DEPLOY_MAIN/index.html"
        else
          rm -f "$DEPLOY_MAIN/index.html.tmp"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
    refs/heads/dev)
      if [ "$newrev" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_DEV"

          mv -f "$DEPLOY_DEV/index.html.tmp" "$DEPLOY_DEV/index.html"
          chmod 644 "$DEPLOY_DEV/index.html"
        else
          rm -f "$DEPLOY_DEV/index.html.tmp"
        fi
      fi
      ;;
  esac
done
EOF

chown -R git:git /git/project
